title: Seasonal and interannual air-sea CO2 exchange on the Pearl River adjacent shelf
query: Using the supplied CMOMS interval-averaged air-sea CO2 flux (CO2_airsea) and surface pCO2, together with daily temperature, salinity, chlorophyll and velocity for 2011-2020, determine when and where the Pearl River adjacent shelf is a net CO2 source or sink. Use valid ocean cells in 112-116 E, 20-23 N with water depth no greater than 200 m. Quantify the monthly cycle, annual net exchange, source/sink area and year-to-year variability, using cell areas and actual averaging intervals. Establish the flux sign and pCO2 units from provider metadata before interpreting them. Examine which changes in temperature, salinity, chlorophyll and circulation accompany the flux changes, testing plausible alternative interpretations. Atmospheric CO2, wind, river carbon loads, dissolved inorganic carbon and alkalinity are not supplied; do not treat correlations or a residual as a closed carbon budget or a complete separation of thermal and biological causes.

region.name: Pearl River adjacent shelf, South China Sea
region.data: CMOMS wet shelf cells in 112-116 E, 20-23 N, bathymetry <=200 m
